def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(x for row in grid for x in row)
    fill = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    background = next((color for color, _ in counts.most_common() if color != fill), fill)

    rows = [r for r in range(h) if grid[r].count(background) > grid[r].count(fill)]
    cols = [c for c in range(w) if sum(grid[r][c] == background for r in range(h)) >
                                      sum(grid[r][c] == fill for r in range(h))]

    out = []

        line = []
        for j in range(len(cols) - 1):
            corners = [grid[rows[i]][cols[j]], grid[rows[i]][cols[j + 1]],

from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    # The tile color is the most frequent row-majority color.
    row_majorities = []
    for row in grid:
        row_majorities.append(Counter(row).most_common(1)[0][0])
    fill = Counter(row_majorities).most_common(1)[0][0]

    # Grid lines contain no tile-colored cells.
    candidate_rows = [r for r in range(h) if fill not in grid[r]]
    candidate_cols = [
        c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] != fill for r in range(h))
    ]

    line_colors = Counter()
    for r in candidate_rows:
        line_colors.update(x for x in grid[r] if x != fill)
    for c in candidate_cols:
        line_colors.update(grid[r][c] for r in range(h) if grid[r][c] != fill)
    background = line_colors.most_common(1)[0][0]

    # Ignore plain outer margins; actual lattice lines carry colored markers.
    rows = [r for r in candidate_rows
            if any(x not in (fill, background) for x in grid[r])]
    cols = [c for c in candidate_cols
            if any(grid[r][c] not in (fill, background) for r in range(h))]

    out = []
    for i in range(len(rows) - 1):
        result_row = []
        for j in range(len(cols) - 1):
            corners = (
                grid[rows[i]][cols[j]],
                grid[rows[i]][cols[j + 1]],
                grid[rows[i + 1]][cols[j]],
                grid[rows[i + 1]][cols[j + 1]],
            )
            result_row.append(corners[0] if len(set(corners)) == 1 else fill)
        out.append(result_row)
    return out
